hypothesis: A B-04 decode that is a TRUE key but carries a non-English LANGUAGE plaintext (Latin/Greek/Old English poetic/Enochian) will score above a seed-3301 order-matched null under a genuinely LANGUAGE-AWARE rune-trigram panel built from that language's own corpus, where it did NOT under the English quadgram gate NOR under C1's orthography-corrected matched-runic scorer. This closes the axis C1 explicitly left not_covered: genuinely language-aware non-English models, not merely orthography-corrected English. Instrument/closure audit (doctrine R1+R6), NOT a new key-space sweep.
verdict: NULL (control-validated). A genuinely language-aware non-English panel (EN/Latin/Greek/Old-English/Enochian) does NOT overturn the B-04 English-only negative on the strongest prior slice; zero survivors at 20,480 decodes. The English-only adjudicator was NOT hiding a non-English plaintext in this slice.
coverage: Re-adjudicated the IDENTICAL C1 B-04 slice: top-40 R20-prior seeds (round20/P3/seedprior20.json, rank-1 1325734783) x 16 B-04 generators (round13/B04/ks.py) x 4 reductions (mod29/rej29/hi_nib/bits5) x 2 signs x 2 atbash x 2 seed-byte-forms, offset 0, L=120, target = real unsolved LP2 head. N = 20,480 decodes. Every decode adjudicated under the English quadgram scorer + a control-VALIDATED language-aware rune-trigram panel {EN, LA, GR, OE, EN0(Enochian)}, with the four R3 language-agnostic statistics (IoC.N, min distinct over 32-rune window, best panel LM, zlib compressibility) persisted per row. Value = coverage(20,480 in this slice) x power(all four non-English registers control-validated: language-LM d-prime STRICTLY exceeds the English quadgram d-prime on each register's own planted text).
not_covered: Old Norse (native / non-translation): UNAVAILABLE - every Old Norse text in the repo (Poetic Edda, Prose Edda, Volsunga/Njal/Grettis/Heimskringla sagas, Kalevala) is an ENGLISH TRANSLATION; native Old-Icelandic mass is <25 special chars. An English translation is an English LM, not a Norse LM (PREREG red-team #1). NOT modelled - refused to fake.

Romanized Hebrew: UNAVAILABLE - the Kabbalah texts hold ~18.7k NATIVE-SCRIPT Hebrew characters (unmappable to the Latin-alphabet rune folder) but only isolated romanized proper nouns (Sephiroth, Kether...); no connected romanized-Hebrew body exists in-repo (measured: 2 parenthetical transliterations, ~20 letters). NOT modelled - refused to fake.
Seeds outside the R20-prior top-40, generators outside round13/B04/ks.py, offsets != 0, deeper R20-prior ranks - the slice is bounded, not the whole B-04 family (identical to C1).
Decoder transition models beyond beam_decode(max_skip=3): the ONE key-skip relation. INHERITS L7-B (skip_by_two, free drift unrepresentable) - lane C2.
Non-linguistic payloads (B6 proved undetectable in principle; degenerate null).

Enochian coverage is thin (~11k letters, the only clean phonetic Angelic corpus in-repo); its LM control-VALIDATED (d-prime 34.4 vs English 7.1 on planted Enochian) so the null over it is sound, but a larger Enochian corpus could tighten it further.
control_detail: passed. validate.py 5/5. control.py plants LATIN, romanized GREEK, genuine OLD ENGLISH (>=2 thorn/edh/aesc lines from the bilingual Beowulf, macrons folded), phonetic ENOCHIAN (analysis/foundation/enoch_text.txt), plus EN_MODERN/EN_NOVOWEL/RAND, enciphers under sha256_ctr(CICADA3301)+encipher_keyskip(0.83), decodes with the CORRECT key at beam_decode(400,3). 100% rune-index recovery on every linguistic register (decoder works; only the adjudicator was in question). Each language-aware trigram LM discriminates its OWN planted language BETTER than the English quadgram scorer (d-prime: LATIN 19.9 vs EN 10.1; GREEK 32.9 vs 10.7; OLD_ENGLISH 17.9 vs 7.8; ENOCHIAN 34.4 vs 7.1; EN_NOVOWEL 17.8 vs -1.0). L7-A gap reproduced: the English scorer places genuine Latin (-5.52), Old English (-5.38) and Enochian (-5.83) AT/BELOW the -5.5 publication bar (would reject them) while each language LM places them ~18-34 SD above its noise floor. RAND floor non-discriminating for the LM (d-prime -0.47) - the LM does not reward arbitrary decodes. All four non-English registers VALIDATED and eligible for the real panel; Old Norse and romanized Hebrew UNAVAILABLE (no honest corpus) and dropped.
threshold: A decode clears iff its panel-max score (max over the control-validated registers) exceeds BOTH (a) the seed-3301 order-matched wrong-key null MAX for the panel-max statistic and (b) the family-wise threshold_for(N=20,480) bar from benchmark/null.py. The panel-max statistic is computed identically for the observed decodes AND the null, so the null already carries the max-over-registers and the bar is correctly inflated for the WIDENED 5-language panel (no double-max). Bars: EN -4.775, panel-max -1.347. Pass conditions fixed in PREREG.md before scoring (control-pass = language-LM d-prime > English d-prime per register; HIT = clears both null-max and family-wise bar).

control.decisive_scope_finding: Unlike C1's matched-runic scorer (which corrects ORTHOGRAPHY only and scored 0.00 on vowel-dropped English), a genuinely language-aware trigram LM built from each language's OWN corpus recovers that language far above the English scorer (2-5x d-prime), including the two registers C1 could not model (Old English poetic, Enochian). The language-aware instrument is real and measured.

red_team.english_translation_trap: avoided by construction - Old English modelled ONLY from genuine thorn/edh/aesc-bearing poem lines, Enochian ONLY from phonetic Angelic text; Old Norse + Hebrew (translation-only / native-script-only) refused rather than faked.
red_team.unvalidated_dimension_inflation: prevented - a register failing its control is dropped before the panel-max; all 4 non-English registers here validated, so none added a noisy max term.

double_max_fp_ceiling.note: widening EN/LA/GR -> +OE +Enochian did NOT inflate the FP rate; identical to C1's 3-language panel and to the alpha=0.01 design, because the seed-3301 null carries the same max-over-registers as the observed statistic.

red_team.seal: R21-L1 SEAL would apply to any bar-clearer (FLAGGED-FOR-ORACLE, never auto-certified); no survivor to flag.

result.decision_relevant: The English-only adjudicator was NOT structurally hiding a non-English plaintext in the strongest prior B-04 slice. A genuinely language-aware panel spanning Latin, Greek, Old English poetic and Enochian - each control-validated to recover its OWN language 2-5x better than the English scorer - yields ZERO survivors, 0.11 (panel) / 1.60 (EN) score-units below the family-wise bar, on decodes with flat IoC, high min-distinct and incompressible R3 stats. Old English and Latin never even beat the panel noise floor. The negatives HOLD across every non-English language that could be honestly modelled from in-repo corpora. Old Norse (translation-only) and romanized Hebrew (no connected corpus) could NOT be honestly tested and remain not_covered - refused rather than faked.

reopens_if: A larger/native Old Norse or connected romanized-Hebrew corpus becomes available in-repo (currently UNAVAILABLE), OR a wider R20-prior depth / non-zero offset / generator outside this slice produces a decode whose language-aware panel score clears the seed-3301 order-matched null max AND the family-wise threshold_for(N) bar. Any survivor is FLAGGED-FOR-ORACLE (R21-L1), never auto-certified.
